decision.observation: From on the parapet ledge, the BINGBONG plane lies just below/beyond: blue wing, propeller, white fuselage with logo, and a huge blue-and-white tail fin sweeping up to the upper-right toward the sky. A small gold dot marker sits at the wing root (0.50,0.48). Stamina full green with reserve.
decision.hypothesis: The plane's tail fin is a massive climbable surface leading upward — likely the way toward the mountain. Dropping onto the wing/fuselage and climbing the tail continues the route.
decision.memory: Plane tail fin = tall climbable structure; gold dot at wing root may mark the objective.
